contracts: (All targeted protected-route cases execute with nonzero discovery and no authorization outcome is influenced by client scope fields.) AND (The account-conflict selector is discovered and proves the credential-derived Account is retained.) AND (The exact role-override selector is discovered and verifies server-derived authorization with nonzero test count.) AND (The principal-conflict selector is discovered and proves the credential-derived Principal is retained.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered and confirms authorization is based on current server role data.)
selector_intents: Execute the protected-route authorization selector with conflicting account, principal, and role fields and observe whether any client field changes authorization outcome or scope.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests.ProtectedRequestAuthorization_ReevaluatesCurrentRoleAfterRemoval verifies current server capability evaluation after role removal.
Run the account-resolution selector with a conflicting client account and observe whether the resolved server Account differs from the credential-derived Account.
Run the principal-resolution selector with a conflicting client principal and observe whether the resolved server Principal differs from the credential-derived Principal.
